appDesc.message: Plays Guitar Flash (guitarflash.com) for you, hitting the notes, and keeps a history of every song. Developed by pwn3ed.

onOpenSite.message: On. Open guitarflash.com and pick a song.

onWaiting.message: On. Waiting for a song to open...

hint.message: With the bot on, open a song on guitarflash.com and press any key to start. Keep the browser window visible.

rankNote.message: Please don't submit bot scores to the rankings.

historySearch.message: Search by song, artist or difficulty

historyClearConfirm.message: Delete the whole history? This cannot be undone.

historyEmpty.message: No songs yet. Turn the bot on and play a song.

braveFpTitle.message: Brave is blocking the game’s notes.

braveFpFix.message: With Brave’s fingerprinting protection on, guitarflash.com cannot load the notes and every song ends right away with nothing to play (even without the bot). To fix it: on guitarflash.com, click the lion (Shields) in the address bar, open the advanced controls, turn off fingerprinting blocking for this site only and reload the page.
